scope: A macOS MCP extension using a client runtime or an installed Node; no embedded Node executable.
execution: Normal Node clients execute the existing entry directly. An Electron runtime relaunches the whole entry once with a locally discovered Node >=22.18, sanitized NODE_/UV_ environment, inherited stdio and forwarded termination. Nothing downloads or installs code.
keySafety: Only established absence permits signing-key creation. Creation is exclusive; a failed read, duplicate creation, cancellation or ambiguous outcome never authorizes replacement. Access credential updates remain separate.
support: macOS13.5+ remains the target; Linux, Windows, real Desktop and independent Intel acceptance remain open.
receipt: The preceding standalone-runtime capture is historical, not evidence for this system-Node deployment. Successor native receipts remain required before admission.
consumer: The base and personalized MCPBs carry the declared public JavaScript dependency closure, not Node, credentials or authority. A recipient using Electron needs an installed compatible Node.
failures: Missing installed Node refuses as runtime/node-required before opening the keychain. Declared JavaScript byte alterations continue to refuse by digest.
boundaries: Synthetic stores and direct MCP clients do not establish real Desktop, quarantine, browser or system-keychain integration. Those remain separate acceptance gates. Existing latency and source budgets require their own current readings.
authority: No runtime, digest, captured execution or review reading admits configuration or authorizes a connection. Owner admission and release approval remain separate acts.
legacyCoordinate: runtime/standalone is retained as an existing review coordinate under this explicitly versioned external-Node deployment. Version1 no-system-Node execution is historical and is not claimed by version2.
